greeting: Hi! Have a question about my services, pricing, portfolio, or working with me? Ask me anything, or tap a question below.
fallback: I'm not totally sure about that one — but here's what I can help with, or reach out directly through the contact form!

questions.a: I offer graphic design (posters, social graphics, brand identity, carousels) and video editing (short-form content, vlogs, promos). Scroll up to the Work section to see examples!

questions.q: How much do you charge for video editing?
questions.a: Video editing starts at $20 for a single short-form video, $35 for two videos, or $10/hr for longer projects. Rush delivery is available too.

questions.q: What graphic design services do you provide?
questions.a: Graphic design starts at $10 for a single design, $30 for a design package (multiple related graphics like a carousel or artboard), or $10/hr for detailed work.

questions.q: How can I work with you?
questions.a: It's simple: send an enquiry → we discuss the project → you submit your materials → editing/design begins → you review & request changes → final delivery. Want to start now?

questions.q: Can I see your previous work?
questions.a: Of course! Scroll up to the Work section — you can filter by category for both Graphic Design and Video Editing, plus a dedicated Vlog Edits section.
Best way is the inquiry form below, or message me on Instagram. I reply to every serious enquiry!
